title: trichophorum cespitosum subsp. austriacum
intro: Trichophorum cespitosum subsp. austriacum, commonly known as Austrian rush or Austrian cottongrass, is a plant species within the family Juncaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine. The plant is said to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, likely due to its therapeutic actions like expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Trichophorum cespitosum subsp. austriacum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
